line: I made this for you, every corner of it. Take your time.
story: We both love music. It's the one thing we always share, even from far away.
So I wanted you to have a place for it, where every song can carry a little of me.
Anything I couldn't say out loud, I put in here for you to find.
notes: You're my home, a place where I can always come to.

notes.label: For you, Precious
notes.note: Thank you for being the Swarnima you are.

notes: I wish to be so close to you that even our atoms get confused about who they belong to.
